evidence.title: Gem Encyclopedia — Sapphire (FACTS)
evidence.fragment: Every color but red; RI 1.762–1.770; SG 4.00; Mohs 9

evidence.title: Ruby Care and Cleaning Guide (корунд)
evidence.fragment: Ultrasonic and steam usually safe for untreated, heat-treated and diffused stones; fracture-filled only with a damp cloth

evidence.title: Millimeter to Diamond Carat Weight Conversion Chart
evidence.fragment: Round: 0.005 ct — 1.0 mm … 1 ct — 6.4 mm … 5 ct — 11.0 mm; sizes are approximate
evidence.limitations: Approximate points; not a production tolerance

evidence.title: Round diamond size chart (secondary retailer)
evidence.fragment: Typical weight–diameter ranges; for example 1.50 ct ≈ 7.3–7.5 mm
evidence.limitations: Secondary retail orientation; not a tolerance or guarantee

evidence.title: Jewellery — Ring-sizes — Definition, measurement and designation; US size chart
evidence.fragment: ISO size = inner circumference; US: d = 11.63 + 0.8128 × size (mm); UK: C = 40 mm, step 1.25 mm
evidence.limitations: Standard annotation plus secondary tables; no JP rule

evidence.title: ГОСТ 30649-99, скан печатного издания, Изм. № 1 и № 2
evidence.fragment: Tables А.1, Б.1, В.1, Г.1 (calculated density); cross-checked with the dnaop.com and meganorm.ru transcriptions on 20.11.2026
evidence.limitations: Third-party copy of the printed edition; not a certified copy
